cards.ex: I try to work out at least three times a week to stay in shape.
cards.exUz: Men haftada kamida uch marta sport bilan shug'ullanaman, qomatimni saqlash uchun.
cards.uzDef: Sport zalida yoki uyda jismoniy mashqlar bajarmoq.

cards.ex: I'm trying to get in shape for my sister's wedding next month.
cards.exUz: Men kelasi oy singlimning to'yiga yaxshi shaklda bo'lishga harakat qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Jismoniy holatini yaxshilash, sog'lomlashtirish.

cards.ex: Don't forget to warm up before you start running to avoid injuries.
cards.exUz: Jarohatlardan saqlanish uchun yugurishni boshlashdan oldin qizishni unutmang.
cards.uzDef: Mashq qilishdan oldin muskullarni tayyorlash.

cards.ex: After a hard workout, it's important to cool down properly.
cards.exUz: Qattiq mashqdan so'ng, to'g'ri sovish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Mashqdan keyin organizmni asta-sekin tinchlantirish.

cards.ex: I'm going to hit the gym after work to lift some weights.
cards.exUz: Ishdan keyin sport zaliga borib, og'irlik ko'taraman.
cards.uzDef: Sport zaliga mashq qilish uchun bormoq.

cards.ex: I was a couch potato all winter, but now I'm ready to get active.
cards.exUz: Men butun qish dangasa edim, lekin endi faol bo'lishga tayyorman.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p vaqtini televizor ko'rish bilan o'tkazadigan odam.

cards.ex: I set a new personal best in the 10k race this weekend.
cards.exUz: Men shu hafta oxirida 10 km masofaga yugurishda yangi shaxsiy rekord o'rnatdim.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsning eng yaxshi natijasi sportda.

cards.ex: She runs every morning to stay in shape.
cards.exUz: U har kuni ertalab qomatini saqlash uchun yuguradi.
cards.uzDef: Jismoniy holatini yaxshi saqlash, doimo mashq qilish.

cards.ex: Regardless of the outcome, sportsmanship is always important.
cards.exUz: Natijadan qat'iy nazar, sportchilik odobi har doim muhim.
cards.uzDef: Sportda adolatli va hurmatli xulq-atvor.

cards.ex: I got winded just walking up the stairs!
cards.exUz: Men shunchaki zinadan chiqib, nafasim qisilib qoldi!
cards.uzDef: Nafas olishda qiyinchilik sezmoq, charchamoq.

cards.ex: I always have muscle soreness the day after a tough workout.
cards.exUz: Qiyin mashqdan keyin har doim muskullarda og'riq bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Mashqdan keyin paydo bo'ladigan muskullardagi og'riq.

cards.ex: You have to push yourself if you want to improve your fitness level.
cards.exUz: Agar jismoniy holatingizni yaxshilashni istasangiz, o'zingizni zo'rlashingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni qiyinlashtirish, ko'proq harakat qilish.

cards.ex: He was on the sidelines for the whole game because of an injury.
cards.exUz: U jarohati tufayli butun o'yin davomida zaxira o'rindig'ida edi.
cards.uzDef: O'yinda qatnashmaslik, tomoshabin bo'lish.

cards.ex: Even a short walk can help you work up a sweat.
cards.exUz: Hatto qisqa sayr ham terlashga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Jismoniy faoliyatdan keyin terlamoq.

cards.ex: She's been doing yoga to tone up her body.
cards.exUz: U tanasini shaklga keltirish uchun yoga bilan shug'ullanadi.
cards.uzDef: Muskullarni shaklga keltirish, mustahkamlash.

cards.ex: I got my second wind around mile five and finished strong.
cards.exUz: Men beshinchi milda ikkinchi nafasimni oldim va kuchli finish qildim.
cards.uzDef: Charchoqdan keyin paydo bo'ladigan energiya.

cards.ex: It's tough, but no pain, no gain!
cards.exUz: Qiyin, lekin og'riqsiz yutuq yo'q!
cards.uzDef: Natijaga erishish uchun harakat va qiyinchilik kerak.

cards.ex: He suffered a serious knee injury during the game.
cards.exUz: U o'yin davomida jiddiy tizza jarohatini oldi.
cards.uzDef: Sport yoki boshqa faoliyat davomida jarohatlanmoq.

cards.ex: Keep in mind that you need to drink plenty of water during exercise.
cards.exUz: Mashq paytida ko'p suv ichish kerakligini esda tuting.
cards.uzDef: Unutmaslik kerak bo'lgan muhim narsani yodda saqlash.

cards.ex: If you want to win, you need to step up your game.
cards.exUz: Agar g'alaba qozonmoqchi bo'lsangiz, o'yiningizni kuchaytirishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'z mahoratini yaxshilash, ko'proq harakat qilish.

cards.ex: After the surgery, he's slowly on the mend.
cards.exUz: Operatsiyadan keyin u asta-sekin tuzalib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Sog'lig'i yaxshilanib bormoqda.

cards.ex: The crowd was cheering on their team.
cards.exUz: Olomon o'z jamoasini qo'llab-quvvatlar edi.
cards.uzDef: Ovoz chiqarib, g'alaba qozonishga ruhlantirmoq.

cards.ex: We need to ensure a level playing field for all athletes.
cards.exUz: Biz barcha sportchilar uchun teng sharoitlarni ta'minlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Adolatli va teng sharoitlar.

cards.ex: I'm really out of shape after not exercising for so long.
cards.exUz: Men juda uzoq vaqt mashq qilmaganimdan keyin formadan chiqdim.
cards.uzDef: Jismoniy holati yomon, mashq qilmaydigan.

cards.ex: I want to take up swimming this summer.
cards.exUz: Men bu yoz suzishni boshlamoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Yangi mashg'ulotni yoki sport turini boshlamoq.

cards.ex: The runner ran out of steam near the end of the race.
cards.exUz: Yuguruvchining poyga oxirida kuchi tugadi.
cards.uzDef: Energiya tugab, davom etishga qurbi yetmaslik.

cards.ex: If you want to win the competition, you need to train hard.
cards.exUz: Agar musobaqada g'alaba qozonmoqchi bo'lsangiz, qattiq mashq qilishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish uchun qattiq mehnat qilmoq.

cards.ex: What's our game plan for the championship game?
cards.exUz: Chempionat o'yini uchun rejamiz qanday?
cards.uzDef: O'yinga tayyorgarlik ko'rish uchun tuzilgan reja.

cards.ex: The team beat the odds and won the championship.
cards.exUz: Jamoa qiyinchiliklarni yengib, chempionatda g'olib chiqdi.
cards.uzDef: Muammo va qiyinchiliklarga qaramay g'alaba qozonmoq.

cards.ex: We need to ensure a level playing field for all competitors.
cards.exUz: Biz barcha raqobatchilar uchun teng sharoitlarni ta'minlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hamma uchun bir xil imkoniyat va sharoitlar.
